name: OpenEMR prior to 5.0.1.4 SQL Injection in encounter parameter
description: SQL Injection in interface/forms/eye_mag/php/Anything_simple.php via the encounter parameter, which is passed unsanitized to getProviderIdOfEncounter() in library/forms.inc
author: AMENDER / Rezwanul Haque
_notes: No EDB entry exists. PoC synthesized. The SQL injection is blind (time-based/error-based). Vulnerable code confirmed in library/forms.inc:getProviderIdOfEncounter() - encounter parameter directly concatenated into SQL. Lab container has session persistence issues preventing live test - vulnerability confirmed via code review.
